claims.claim: You must not be a British national to need a Student visa.
claims.note: None of the sources say British nationals are excluded from or do not need a Student visa.

claims.claim: You must not be an Irish national to need a Student visa.
claims.quote: You do not need to apply for a visa if you’re an Irish citizen.
claims.note: The text says Irish citizens do not need to apply for a visa.

claims.claim: You must not already have leave to remain that covers the course.
claims.quote: If you have settled or pre-settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme, you do not need to apply for a visa.
claims.note: The text only says people with settled or pre-settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme do not need a visa; it does not state a general rule about any leave to remain that covers the course.
